text: Based on the evidence provided, approximately 2.23% of the property was affected by tree-cover loss in 2021. This corresponds to an area of about 81.3 hectares. The loss was primarily in planted forest, with 68.1 hectares of Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda affected. The evidence supports the occurrence of tree-cover loss but does not specify the cause or whether it was legal or authorized.
